name: Budgie
description: Desktop environment by Buddies of Budgie.
summary: AI tools are allowed with humans as accountable authors: non-trivial AI-assisted code must be tested and carry an Assisted-by trailer. Code for the Budgie 11 rewrite should be human-crafted for now. AI help with issue and PR text needs no attribution.

evidence.quote: It is our position that only humans can be authors and ultimately be held accountable.
Non-trivial AI-assisted code must be built, installed, and tested by the contributor
When AI tools assisted with code changes (writing, modifying, or generating code), add an Assisted-by trailer to the commit message with the tool and model identifier.
We kindly request that contributions to Budgie 11 minimize the use of large language models and AI tooling for code generation.
improve the clarity of communicating everything from blog posts to writing issues and pull requests.
AI was used to help write documentation for issues or pull requests (not committed code)

sources.title: AI Policy | Buddies of Budgie Docs
